name: cdn-relay-ip-block
description: The relay's address is null-routed at the border (as relay-ip-block), while Cloudflare's edges stay open. Every direct family dies; the CDN route, dialled at an edge address from the signed seeds with the zone's name inside ECH, is what must carry (op cdn). Plan §2.1: the add-on's first rescue.
analogue: A burned VPS address with Cloudflare's ranges untouched: the common death of a REALITY address on MCI (2-7 days), and the reason the CDN route is in the pack from day one (plan decision 2). Model: one relay address silently dropped; every edge address answers. Not modelled: per-ISP Cloudflare prefix health (cdn-edge-allowlist and cdn-grey-budget are two shapes of it), Cloudflare's own interference with long VLESS-over-WebSocket flows (a real-account gate).
